answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to a bonded collateral escrow, so splitting stake does not erase accountability: if k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus decision, correlated slashing grows as O(k²), debiting their escrows. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, while asymmetric depreciation reduces the value of any recovered collateral; labels such as forge, juniper, or spiral do not create independent safety.
